name: qa
description: Plan and write the team's testing: the project's master test plan, a plan per feature with scope and exit criteria, test cases traced to acceptance criteria, a regression matrix, and the handoff a developer owes QA. Afterwards, records a test run, raises its failures as bugs, and records a fixed bug's retest, and brings existing cases level with a changed spec. Use when a project starts testing, a feature reaches QA or has no written cases, a release needs a regression pass, the spec changed under existing cases, results need recording, or cases need review before approval. Triggers on: "test plan", "master test plan", "test case", "QA", "regression", "update the test cases", "test results", "log the failed cases as bugs", "retest", "review these test cases", "how do we test this", "QA handoff", "/atk:qa".

findings.excerpt: /atk:qa <requirement-path>      # Test plan plus cases from a requirement artifact
